body.x: Multi-screen video leader SeaChange International(SEAC, http://www.schange.com) will demonstrate a range of its cloud-based video solutions at the 2012 International CES in Las Vegas (Jan. 10-13), including its breakthrough MediaWare converged gateway solution, the award-winning Nitro subscriber experience software, and the next-generation Infusion advanced advertising platform. Booth 25126, Lower South Hall, Las Vegas Convention Center.

SeaChange International (Nasdaq: SEAC) is a global leader in multi-screen video. The Company provides open, cloud-based, Emmy award-winning solutions and services for back office, advertising, content, in-home devices and broadcast to hundreds of media companies, including all major cable operators in the U.S., Europe and Latin America, plus other blue-chip companies such as Virgin Media, AT&T, Hutchison Whampoa, and DISH Network. Headquartered in Acton, Massachusetts, SeaChange is TL 9000 certified and has product development, support and sales offices around the world.
